notes.title: Patch 2.4.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Feature: [b]ACTIVE PAUSE[/b]. Player can now pause any time during a mission to issue commands (deploy units, use powers, mine new a block, etc.). This should help ease the difficulty curve.
[*] Fixed an issue with Asian fonts not being displayed properly
[*] Fixed a visual bug with Hacker enemy
[*] Fixed a bug where player is unable to Exit to Main Menu from the Upgrade Terminal screen
[*] Other minor UI fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.4.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Implemented Hotkeys for Keyboard/Mouse players
[*] Enhanced overall lighting/visuals
[*] Adjusted Outline effect to improve performance on low-end PC
[*] Changed various Hub dialogues
[*] Fixed a bug with Mission 23 Star (Mine 20 blocks) requiring 25 blocks
[*] Fixed incorrect wording on the Scam giveaway email
[*] Reduced length for ZAP mission and lowered corresponding star requirements
[*] Other minor UI bug fixes
[*] Various optimization changes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.3.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] - Added a new Inbox message scenario for White Hat Contest challenge
[*] - Fixed issue where Endless mode achievements are not visible at the start
[*] - Slight adjustment to some units' stats for Endless mode balancing purposes
[*] - Made improvements to localized languages
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix 2.3.8.1 (PC Only)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with cursor not locked in Windows mode for PC
[*] Fixed issue with GOG Galaxy SDK achievement sync
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date and Steam Festival Demo
notes.content:
[h1]Release Date[/h1]
We are excited to announce that [b]Crypto: Against All Odds[/b] will officially launch on Steam (PC & MacOS) on [u]March 02, 2021[/u]. The game will be published by our partner, Plug-In Digital Publishing. Wishlist the game now to get notified about special launch discount.

[h1]Steam Festival Demo[/h1]
As part of the Steam Game Festival (Feb 03 - Feb 09), a playable demo is also available for a limited time. 
Our team at Pictagor Games will also be streaming a playthrough and providing developer's commentaries throughout the Festival. Come hang out with us and ask any question, or download the demo and discover the game yourself! Don't forget to click the "Wishlist" button to help our store visibility.

[h1]Stay tuned for special giveaways[/h1]
As we approach the upcoming release date, we will be doing a lot of giveaways to the communities. Come join our [url=https://discord.gg/NchzMvE]Discord[/url] to stay updated. Don't miss out on these events! You will have the chance to win a copy of the game and various merch.
